title: Replica-Aware Validation of Machine Learning for Reliable Interpretation of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories: Cav3.1 Reproducibility Package
description: Reproducibility package accompanying the manuscript Replica-Aware Validation of Machine Learning for Reliable Interpretation of Molecular Dynamics Trajectories: A Case Study of the Cav3.1 Channel. It contains analysis code, processed structural features from three independent replicas of apo, Z944-bound, and mZ944-bound Cav3.1, initial structures, one-frame example trajectories, representative NAMD and MM/GBSA configurations, compact auxiliary inputs, and validated result tables. Full production trajectories are available from the corresponding author upon reasonable request. Code is licensed under MIT; data and documentation are licensed under CC BY 4.0.
